proposed_decision.rule: Approve exactly 100 governed D02 concepts with A1=20 A2=20 B1=25 B2=35 and global indices 0101..0200; approval is semantic-reference authority only.

governance_decisions.proposal: Accept PT and EN reference labels subject to recorded ambiguity/one-to-one flags; no external language selects HNK form or meaning.
Accept 75 Esperanto entries as HIGH_CONFIDENCE internal references without claiming item-by-item Akademio attestation; retain 25 entries explicitly PROVISIONAL pending later lexicographic validation.

Preserve reviewed semantic families as distinct where intentionally modeled: generic family vs family structures; generic parent vs biological/birth/legal/adoptive/foster roles; generic child vs step/adopted/foster child; partner/spouse/couple/marriage/cohabitation/legal unions; friend/acquaintance/friendship/close friend/best friend; relative/kinship/consanguinity/affinity/in-law; gendered kin terms vs generic hypernyms.

Accept 20 existing-HNK mappings only as semantic cross-references. PUPUKU/NEKUVO and the authored D02 forms retain current authority; PAPA and MAMA remain GATE/HOLD and receive no HNK3000 credit or semantic generalization.
Keep HNK3000 Wave05+ form generation paused. Semantic-master work may continue to Batch03 D03 after this review while all 25 provisional Esperanto entries remain visibly flagged.

external_esperanto_boundary: Core roots were spot-checked against Akademia Vortaro, but HIGH_CONFIDENCE is an internal semantic-reference status, not item-by-item Akademio certification. PROVISIONAL entries require later lexical validation.
approval_rule: A future SIGA in this semantic-master thread may approve only DEC-HNK3000-PTEO-B02-REV-001 through DEC-HNK3000-PTEO-B02-REV-006 if this gate remains materially unchanged.
